_doc: Equihash ASIC seller directory. Manufacturer-direct and independent channels are labelled separately. equihash.com does not sell hardware, does not accept payment for placement, and does not treat a public listing as an endorsement. null = n/a.

vendors.name: BITMAIN
vendors.region_note: BITMAIN's own online shop. Delivery eligibility and cost depend on the destination selected in its checkout.
vendors.verification_label: Official sales channel confirmed on BITMAIN Support
vendors.notes: Use shop.bitmain.com for manufacturer-direct orders. Other sellers in this directory are independent businesses.

vendors.name: The Mining Shop UK
vendors.region_note: Independent UK retailer in Hartlepool. Its Z15 Pro page states UK delivery is included and describes DDP delivery from a UK/EU warehouse.
vendors.verification_label: Legal name and active status matched in Companies House
vendors.notes: Not an official BITMAIN distributor; BITMAIN says it has no official distributors or resellers.

vendors.name: Antminer Distribution Europe B.V.
vendors.region_note: Independent Dutch retailer shipping from Breda. It states worldwide delivery, EU pickup and EU VAT registration.
vendors.verification_label: Legal name, address and KvK number matched to an external company record
vendors.notes: Despite its name, this is not an official BITMAIN distributor; BITMAIN says it has no official distributors or resellers.

vendors.name: Apexto Mining
vendors.region_note: Independent retailer. Its product page describes international shipping and DDP service for selected destinations.
vendors.verification_label: Legal name and registration numbers matched to Hong Kong Companies Registry notices
vendors.notes: Not an official BITMAIN distributor; BITMAIN says it has no official distributors or resellers.

vendors.name: Hashlabs
vendors.region_note: Broker and hosting provider. Its Z15 Pro page presents destination-specific delivered and hosted offers, confirmed by written quote.
vendors.verification_label: Legal name and UEN matched to a Singapore company directory record
vendors.notes: Offers are confirmed by Hashlabs in writing before payment. This is not an official BITMAIN distributor.

vendors.name: BT-MINERS
vendors.region_note: Independent retailer and repair/hosting provider. Its public contact page lists regional phone lines and the Hong Kong operating company.
vendors.verification_label: Operator name and Hong Kong business registration published in the seller terms
vendors.notes: Not an official BITMAIN distributor for purposes of this directory; BITMAIN says it has no official distributors or resellers. Seller claims of manufacturer relationships are not treated as authorization without manufacturer evidence.

vendors.name: OneMiners
vendors.region_note: Retail and hosted-mining brand operated by CircleHash LLC. The company publishes US, Prague and Dubai contact locations.
vendors.verification_label: Legal name, Wyoming filing and OneMiners trade name matched to public records
vendors.notes: Offers include delivery and hosted deployment variants. Read the selected variant, energy charges and hosting agreement before payment. This is not an official BITMAIN distributor.
